newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks finish with slight increase.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks finish with slight increase.

text.p: Argentine stocks finished the week with a slight increase on strong selective buying amid thin trading volumes.
"The market has started a process of correction with a support objective of 562 points on the Merval," said Jorge Bonanno, an analyst at financial consultants Interfin.
The leading blue-chip Merval index Friday rose 0.07 percent to finish at 584.32. In the last five days, it has amassed gains of 1.16 percent.
This also was the seventh week in a row that stocks went up -- the first time this happens in nearly three years.
But this scenario is likely to lead to the onslaught of profit-taking soon, allowing players to re-enter on the buy side at lower prices.
"Even though volumes were low this session, we are finishing a positive week but I think we will see a stronger bout of profit-taking next week," said a trader at an Argentine bank.
Even so players insist that the outlook for stocks is positive, considering the increasing signs of a pick-up in growth, which will ultimately translate into higher profits by companies.
